answer: The finality of attestations only counts when the attestator is established, so a fresh cluster of aliases cannot push any transaction to finality until it has spent many epochs proving honesty. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a sonnet as the anchor of the cost.
